products.description:
Run Microsoft Purview as an operated, measured compliance program

Turning Purview on is the start; running it is where value (or drift) happens. This solution is the Purview operating model: a policy lifecycle (design→simulate→enforce→review), Compliance Manager improvement-action cadence, alert triage and reporting across DLP/labels/insider-risk/audit, periodic role and access reviews, change control, and the KPIs/dashboards that prove the program is healthy — so Purview stays effective, tuned, and defensible over time.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Purview operating model: policy lifecycle, Compliance Manager cadence, alerting/triage, reporting, role reviews, and change control.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (an implemented Purview foundation, roles, reporting data sources, governance stakeholders).
  • Operating Guide — stand up the policy lifecycle + change control, run the Compliance Manager improvement cadence, wire alert triage + reporting, schedule role/access reviews, and operate the KPI dashboards — each runbook named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Runbook Library + validation gates (policies reviewed, alerts triaged, roles reviewed, KPIs trending) plus Best Practices for a durable, measured Purview program.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Microsoft Purview run as a living program — policies reviewed on a cadence, alerts triaged, roles reviewed, and KPIs proving health — effective, tuned, and defensible year over year.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVOPS-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Purview policy inventory + drift/health assessment across DLP, sensitivity labels, auto-labeling, and retention. Makes no changes
    • PURVOPS-KpiReport.ps1 — read-only program-health KPI dashboard from live Purview telemetry plus a Compliance Manager improvement-actions export. Makes no changes
    • PURVOPS-Remediation.ps1 — change-controlled Purview ops/config helper: promote a piloted policy to enforce, or roll it back. -WhatIf by DEFAULT; writes only with -Commit
    • PURVOPS-Report.ps1 — read-only alert/incident rollup across DLP, insider risk, information-protection, and audit from the Microsoft Graph security API. Makes no changes
    • PURVOPS-Validation.ps1 — read-only Purview role & access review: enumerate compliance role groups + members and diff against an approved baseline. Makes no changes

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
